description: Region of Emilia-Romagna publishes eleven map-edition entries covering marked walking routes in five regional-park areas. The description explicitly states that the routes receive periodic maintenance to retain pedestrian access. Coverage is Emilia-Romagna regional parks. The physical route layouts can provide active-mobility network and access inputs for transport simulations. The grouped resource has 11 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The source states restricted use for intellectual-property reasons and links its restricted-use terms; no open reuse licence or price is assumed. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. The source lists paper maps and a geoportal, not verified downloadable route files. Editions from 2017 to 2023 are grouped; present route condition and access cannot be inferred. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2017-07-13 to 2024-11-21; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
